title: wt refs purge --dry-run --json
description: What `wt refs purge` would delete: the pins of the runs named, or of every run older than --older-than. Printed by `wt refs purge --json` without --yes as the only thing on stdout; it deletes nothing. Schema 1: fields may be added and enumerations may gain values; nothing is renamed or removed. See docs/json.md.

olderThan.description: --older-than as given; null when runs were named.

token.description: Names the plan: pass it to --yes --expect. Null when there is nothing to purge, or on error.

sweptAt.description: Unix seconds the run began: its meta's sweptAt, else the time in its id.

meta.description: refs/wt-swept/<runId>/meta, deleted last; null when the run has none.

url.description: origin's one effective URL, fetch and push alike, insteadOf and pushInsteadOf applied, with all userinfo removed (git@host:o/r is host:o/r).

digest.description: sha256: and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the effective URL's UTF-8 bytes.

endpoint.description: The origin the run's meta records; null for a local run or a run with no meta.

id.description: refs/heads/<name> or refs/tags/<name> here; origin:refs/heads/<name> or origin:refs/tags/<name> on origin. --only takes it, one id per flag and never split: a ref name may contain a comma.
refs/heads/<name> or refs/tags/<name> here; origin:refs/heads/<name> or origin:refs/tags/<name> on origin. --only takes it, one id per flag and never split: a ref name may contain a comma.

unreachable.description: Each pin whose commits no ref outside this purge reaches, and how many: what git gc may take once the pins go. A commit two purged pins share counts for both.
